potential_flow_cylinder — DRIVE swarmflow op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.potential_flow_cylinder(x, y, cylinder, speed: 'float' = 1.0, grid: 'bool' = False) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import swarmflow; swarmflow.potential_flow_cylinder(x, y, cylinder, speed: 'float' = 1.0, grid: 'bool' = False) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("potential_flow_cylinder"))

Usage

Potential flow around a cylinder (closed form). u − i v = U (1 − R²/(z − z_c)²); NaN inside the circle.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

grid=True なら x・y を格子の軸(1 次元、行 = y の順)とみなし、速度場の dict(module の規約)を返す。既定の grid=False は要素ごと(同じ形に broadcast)に u・v・inside を返す —— 軸か点の列かを形で推し量らない(同じ長さの 1 次元の x と y はどちらにも読めて、点の列が黙って格子になる)。どちらにも stagnation(上流の衝突点(x_c − R, y_c))と rear_stagnation と surface_speed_max(= 2U)を付ける。
